basic_details.short_information: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) on its official website for the recruitment of 1 Junior Research Fellow post. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates with an M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or allied relevant branches, or a B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering with a valid GATE qualification, seeking a contractual research position.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or allied relevant branches with GATE qualification, or a B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering with GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year, plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is MNNIT Allahabad located?
faq.answer: MNNIT Allahabad is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211004.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job as indicated in the recruitment details.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.
